'''0.26h''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that fixed some bugs and crashes.

==Changelog==
* Fixed the display of messages from administrators
* Improved application stability, fixed some crashes related to lack of memory
* Fixed a bug which caused a transition to the login menu from within the game
